name: Intersport Via Ferrata (Donnerkogel)
summary: Famous for its spectacular 40-meter 'Sky Ladder' bridge suspended over a deep gorge, this panoramic route climbs the ridge of the Großer Donnerkogel with breathtaking views of the Dachstein glacier.

name: Drachenwand Via Ferrata
summary: A highly popular and scenic alpine route above Lake Mondsee featuring minimal artificial steps, exposed ridge climbing, and a thrilling aerial suspension bridge near the summit.

name: Stuibenfall Via Ferrata
summary: An exhilarating, family-friendly valley climb running directly alongside Tyrol's biggest waterfall, complete with wire-rope bridges that cross directly over the roaring torrents.

name: Innsbruck Via Ferrata (Nordkette)
summary: A long, high-alpine ridge traverse spanning multiple peaks of the Nordkette range. Offers constant, breathtaking exposure directly over the city of Innsbruck and the Inn Valley.

name: Hans von Haidsteig (Rax)
summary: One of Austria's oldest and most classic sports climbs, weaving up the vertical Preiner Wand utilizing historical iron ladders, chimney cracks, and steep rock faces.

name: Seewand Klettersteig
summary: One of the longest, most physically demanding, and technically punishing via ferratas in Austria. Rises brutally out of Hallstatt Lake over polished limestone and relentless vertical walls.

name: Zahme Gams Via Ferrata
summary: A short, crisp beginner route located right in the mountaineering village of Weißbach bei Lofer, designed with perfect protection for those practicing fundamental foot placements.

name: Kaiserschild Klettersteig
summary: An airy and steep sports klettersteig ending at an altitude of roughly 2,000m in Styria, offering spectacular, dizzying views toward the Eisenerzer Alps.

name: Seewand Klettersteig
summary: One of the longest, most physically demanding, and technically punishing via ferratas in Austria. Rises brutally out of Hallstatt Lake over polished limestone and relentless vertical walls.

name: Arena Variant - Bürgeralm Klettersteig
summary: A short but incredibly athletic sport via ferrata in Styria featuring sustained vertical walls, a zip line option, and a punishing, overhanging finish that requires explosive upper body power.

name: Postalmklamm Klettersteig (F-Variant)
summary: While the main gorge traverse is a scenic C/D, the optional escape route features an extreme, heavily overhanging vertical wall graded F, requiring absolute mastery of short-fixing and massive arm strength.

name: Bürgeralm 'Der lachende Piber'
summary: A highly exposed sport route utilizing minimal natural footholds. It features a technical sequence crossing sheer slab faces and a final aerial exit over the panoramic wall.

name: Königsjodler Klettersteig
summary: Austria's most iconic high-alpine traverse. Spanning the Hochkönig massif, it features a relentless series of sharp rock towers, a flying fox, and constant D-grade technical movement at high altitude.

name: Zillertal Klettersteig (Huterlaner - Pfeilspitzwand Extreme)
summary: An athletic valley klettersteig branching into extreme variations. Features slick vertical rock plates and highly exposed traverses with minimal iron steps directly above Mayrhofen.

name: Madersbacher Weg Klettersteig
summary: A brutally steep sport climb on limestone cliffs. It forces climbers into extended sequences of overhanging friction climbs and arm-draining clips with massive exposure.

name: Eisenerzer Klettersteig
summary: A rugged, classic alpine route up the Pfaffenstein. It tests endurance across relentless vertical pillars and exposed, blocky alpine terrain with demanding downclimbs.
